Ask if it is coming from the same warehouse as the damaged one, explaining you want to make sure the same issue is not being resent. Ask what to do with the damaged one since you do not need to return it, and mention you could put it in your building's electronics bin. Say you do not see the confirmation email yet; once the agent says it was sent, say you see it (order 8821, zero balance) and will upload photos. Then ask whether there are any updates on the headphones order. Accept that it stays as is and say you will use the link tonight if nothing changes. Thank the agent for handling two issues and end the call.

instructions.reason_for_call: You returned an item at a Westline store over a week ago and the money for the refund still has not come back to your account.
instructions.known_info:
You are Teddy Torrez.
The email on the order is teddy.torrez@harbormail.com.
The order number ends in 5624 and the return receipt ends in 9182.
The item was a black standing desk converter you ordered online and returned to a store because it was too wide for your desk.
You paid 40 dollars with a Westline gift card and the rest with your debit card.
You got an email about the gift card portion with a new digital gift card number, which you have not tried yet.
You are still missing 146 dollars and 42 cents. Your bank shows no refund, not even a pending one.
The debit card you paid with ended in 2047. It was replaced last month and the new card ends in 8163. You believe both are linked to the same checking account.
You were charged a small overdraft fee because you were expecting this money back.
instructions.unknown_info: You do not know the status of the debit refund at Westline or how long a trace takes.
instructions.task_instructions:
Open by saying you are trying to figure out what happened to a refund: you returned something at a store over a week ago and the money has not come back. Say it was ordered online, returned to the store, a black standing desk converter that was too wide for your desk. Give the order and return receipt endings (speak digits one at a time) and your email when asked. Confirm the total sounds right by saying you paid 40 dollars with a Westline gift card and the rest on debit. Say the store told you the return was done, but your email only covered the gift card part and you are still missing 146 dollars and 42 cents. Confirm you got a digital gift card number but have not tried it and are more worried about the debit card.

When told the debit refund was not confirmed, ask what that means and whether Westline sent it or not, since your bank shows nothing pending. Then mention your card was replaced last month but should be linked to the same checking account, and ask if that could be an issue. Give the old and new card last four when asked. Ask them to just send it to the new card. Ask how long it will take, noting nine days already feels long, then ask if you might be waiting another week. Ask if a reissue would be a check, saying you do not want store credit for the whole amount. Ask them to confirm the 40 dollar gift card actually works. After the trace is opened, ask them to email it to you. Say you see the email and that it says not to contact the store, and ask whether that means the store cannot do anything. Then mention the small overdraft fee and ask whether Westline covers it; say you just wanted it on record. Ask whether you need to call if the refund appears before then. Say you still wish it were back today but it makes more sense now, say that is everything, thank the agent and end the call.
